clauses.scope_note: Section 8.2. Separate from DeepSeek’s reserved remedial measures, this paragraph makes you responsible for third-party liabilities, claims, demands, or losses resulting from the specified circumstances and requires compensation of DeepSeek for losses incurred in protecting its rights. This clause models only those user duties.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_of_services_or_account_by_you_or_account_user means you or a user of your account uses the Services; the duties apply when the resulting third-party claims or losses arise from a breach of the Terms, violation of applicable law or third-party rights, fraud or other illegal acts, or intentional misconduct or gross negligence. If DeepSeek is also at fault, liability is apportioned according to degree of fault under applicable law.

obligation_items.content: Be responsible for legal liabilities, claims, demands, or losses asserted by third parties resulting from a breach of the Terms, violation of applicable laws or regulations or third-party rights, fraud or other illegal acts, or intentional misconduct or gross negligence; where DeepSeek is also at fault, liability is apportioned according to degree of fault under applicable law.
obligation_items.object: Third-party liabilities, claims, demands, or losses resulting from your or a user of your account’s conduct
obligation_items.trigger: When such third-party liabilities, claims, demands, or losses result from the specified conduct; if DeepSeek is also at fault, apportion liability according to degree of fault under applicable law.

obligation_items.content: Compensate DeepSeek for losses incurred in protecting its rights, including the listed fees, costs, compensation, liquidated damages, settlement costs, and administrative fines.
obligation_items.object: DeepSeek’s losses incurred in protecting its rights
obligation_items.trigger: When DeepSeek incurs such losses in protecting its rights in connection with the specified circumstances.

clauses.scope_note: Export Control and Sanctions section. In addition to the separately anchored prohibitions on specified service uses and Input contents, this clause models the express responsibility to comply with all applicable Export Control and Sanctions Laws relating to your and your end users’ access to and use of the Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: access_to_or_use_of_services_by_you_or_end_user means you or an end user accesses or uses the Services. Applicable Export Control and Sanctions Laws are the laws and regulations defined in the paragraph as Export Control and Sanctions Laws.

obligation_items.content: Comply with all applicable Export Control and Sanctions Laws relating to your and your end users’ access to and use of the Services.
obligation_items.object: Access to and use of the Services by you and your end users
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever you or an end user accesses or uses the Services, to the extent applicable Export Control and Sanctions Laws govern that access or use.

coverage_notes: The separate, unrepresentable liability limitations in section 8.4 (line 413) are not a target paragraph and are not re-extracted.

paragraph_audit.reason: The existing anchor covers DeepSeek’s reserved remedial measures; the added clause models the paragraph’s separate user responsibility for specified third-party claims and compensation duty.
Section 8.4 is a limitation of liability allocating or disclaiming liability; it imposes no behavioral duty or activity constraint.
The existing anchors cover restricted service uses and prohibited Input content; the added clause captures the separate express duty to comply with applicable Export Control and Sanctions Laws.
